recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, overexposed photograph of a hand making a peace sign, painted with an American flag motif, set against a vibrant, blurry psychedelic background of yellow, red, and blue light leaks.
coreVisualRelationships: Hand gesture as the central vertical anchor
High-key lighting washing out the top of the hand
Saturated primary color background contrasting with the hand's white and blue paint
Text aligned horizontally across the top margin
coreInvariants: Star pattern on the extended fingers
Red stripe at the base of the wrist
Intense yellow and red bokeh background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centrally placed hand, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark blue, star-patterned fingers against the bright sky-like background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top text, moves down the fingers to the palm, and settles on the red base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Active negative space filled with colorful, blurry light leaks and lens flare effects.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Bright yellow and orange light leaks in the background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep navy blue on the fingers providing a dark silhouette against the light.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red band at the bottom and white stars.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extremely high saturation with blown-out highlights (high-key) creating a glowing effect.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Solid five-pointed star used as a glyph separator

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the upper margin over the sky area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Same family, varying posture (upright vs. italic) separated by a graphic symbol.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and wide stance.
Provides the necessary geometric weight and sharp terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast photo of a hand making a peace sign. The fingers are painted navy blue with white stars, the palm is white, and the wrist has a thick red stripe. The background is a psychedelic blur of bright yellow, orange, and red light leaks with a hint of blue sky at the top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two words in a bold, wide geometric sans-serif font at the top. The first word is upright, followed by a solid star icon, and the second word is italicized. Use black ink with wide tracking.

verificationChecks: Is the hand gesture clearly a peace sign?
Are the stars only on the two extended fingers?
Is the background sufficiently blurry and saturated?
Is the text centered at the top margin?

adjustableVariables: Number of stars on the fingers
Thickness of the red wrist band
mustRedesign: Specific band names or album titles

avoid: Grunge or distressed textures on the text

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red band is at the bottom edge
Verify the text is uppercase and geometric
Confirm the background is a colorful bokeh blur
recipe.reuseFormula: Central hand subject + flag-inspired paint + overexposed lighting + psychedelic bokeh background + top-aligned geometric sans-serif text.
